_about: Sage standard cost in £ per garment, by stock code, for every product made in-house (Tibard and Oliver Harvey). The dashboard values the garments the production planner shows as completed each month at these costs, from the month in FEED_FROM.value (kpi-feeds.js). While this list is empty the on-shore £ typed into the KPI Data sheet is shown instead.
